name: DrainQueue

test_list.description: Records are received in the order they were pushed.
When all slots are in use new records are dropped and counted; queued ones are kept (explicit overflow policy).
50,000 pushes with no consumer return and accepted + dropped == 50,000.
Slots return to the free list after each receive; steady traffic never drops.
close() delivers everything queued before it and then ends the consumer loop.
A push after close is dropped and counted; a closed empty queue ends wait_for_items.
flush(timeout) is false while nobody consumes and true once the consumer has drained and flushed.
Lines above the line limit are truncated and flagged; slot buffers never grow.

inputs.name: rec
inputs.description: Redacted record to hand to the drain thread.

output_description: Bounded multi-producer single-consumer queue of reusable slots; producers never wait for the consumer.
